description: This PHP class, PasswordStrengthValidation, is responsible for evaluating the strength of user passwords using the Zxcvbn library and assigning a corresponding strength score. It is part of the OrangeHRM authentication utility package.

classes.name: PasswordStrengthValidation
classes.description: A utility class that assesses the strength of a given user password using the Zxcvbn library, providing discrete strength ratings.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the PasswordStrengthValidation class by creating an instance of the Zxcvbn password strength estimator.

methods.name: checkPasswordStrength
methods.description: Evaluates the password strength of a given UserCredential object and returns a corresponding strength score as an integer.
